contribution_delta: A matched manipulation that separates aggregation-depth effects from label-noise effects in the fictional benchmark
decision_if_resolved: Choose depth or data-quality interventions based on the observed causal contrast

benchmark.unit_of_analysis: Independent graph instance, with nodes clustered within graph
benchmark.contamination_check: Audit generator seeds and graph IDs across train, validation and held-out test splits
benchmark.test_set_access_policy: Freeze model and decisions before opening held-out graph instances
benchmark.benchmark_limitations: Synthetic graphs may not represent real graph distributions

data_identity.evidence_or_action: Hash graph IDs and label files before training

split_integrity.evidence_or_action: Verify disjoint graph-generator seeds across splits

preprocessing.evidence_or_action: Compare normalization and feature construction with the reference code

metric_sanity.evidence_or_action: Test accuracy evaluator on hand-labeled tiny graphs

baseline_fidelity.evidence_or_action: Run the reference baseline under its documented configuration

reference_reproduction.evidence_or_action: Attempt a matched reference-result reproduction before interpreting a deficit

comparison_fairness.baseline_source: Fictional reference baseline implementation, to be verified
comparison_fairness.baseline_implementation: Same code path except the declared depth/noise interventions
comparison_fairness.training_data_budget: Same training graph count per condition
comparison_fairness.compute_budget: Matched accelerator time or report deviations
comparison_fairness.tuning_budget: Same validation trials and early-stopping rule per condition
comparison_fairness.information_access: Same features, labels and validation feedback per condition

analysis.effect_measure: Depth-by-noise interaction in held-out accuracy drop
analysis.decision_threshold: A prespecified five-percentage-point contrast for this fictional test
analysis.uncertainty_method: Cluster bootstrap over independent graph instances
analysis.aggregation_unit: Independent graph instance, with nodes clustered within graph
analysis.seed_policy: Use multiple fixed generator and training seeds selected before outcome inspection
analysis.multiple_testing_policy: One primary contrast; label secondary comparisons exploratory
analysis.failed_run_policy: Retain every attempted run and diagnose failures before excluding any
analysis.holdout_policy: Do not use held-out graphs for tuning or prompt selection

experiments.purpose: Distinguish aggregation-depth effect from label-noise effect
experiments.focal_condition: Increase message-passing depth while fixing label noise
experiments.comparator_condition: Fix depth while increasing label noise
experiments.variable_changed: Depth and noise are separately randomized in a factorial design
experiments.outcome: Held-out node accuracy aggregated by independent graph
experiments.predicted_if_focal: Depth increase produces the larger accuracy drop under degree shift
experiments.predicted_if_rival: Noise increase produces the larger drop while depth contrast remains small
experiments.falsifying_result: The prespecified depth contrast is absent with adequate precision and valid checks
experiments.indeterminate_result: Metric or split checks fail, or uncertainty overlaps both explanations
experiments.analysis_action: Estimate the prespecified depth-by-noise contrast and interval

experiments.purpose: Check whether extra aggregation is necessary for the predicted effect
experiments.focal_condition: Remove extra aggregation at fixed label noise
experiments.comparator_condition: Retain extra aggregation at fixed label noise
experiments.outcome: Held-out node accuracy aggregated by independent graph
experiments.predicted_if_focal: Removing extra aggregation reduces the degree-shift deficit
experiments.predicted_if_rival: Removing extra aggregation has little effect when label noise is held fixed
experiments.falsifying_result: No depth-associated change under a valid matched test
experiments.indeterminate_result: Training instability prevents a reliable comparison
experiments.analysis_action: Compare matched conditions with graph-level uncertainty
